daily.today_energy: Mercury's whispering something interesting today, Virgo. Your intuition is stronger than usual—trust those little gut feelings. There's a subtle shift happening that wants you to loosen your grip on control and just vibe with the flow.
daily.love: If you're coupled up, today's about showing up authentically instead of perfectly. Single? Someone's noticing your energy. The universe is reminding you that your worth isn't about having all the answers.
daily.career: Your analytical superpowers are peaked right now, but don't get lost in the details. Step back and see the bigger picture. A collaboration or conversation could spark something genuinely cool if you stay open.
daily.health: Your nervous system's asking for gentleness today. Whether that's a walk, journaling, or just putting your phone down—listen to what feels grounding. Your body knows what it needs.

weekly.overview: Mercury's doing its thing in your sector of introspection this week, Virgo. It's giving quiet power moves and mental clarity. Trust those gut feelings—they're more accurate than your usual overthinking spiral. This is your moment to plant seeds.
weekly.love: Venus is whispering softly in your corner. Whether you're coupled or solo, there's an invitation to be more vulnerable and less perfect. Someone's noticing your realness. Let them in a little. Authenticity hits different right now.
